name: Fire Charm
body:
Sutra Type charm [fire]

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Range touch
Target one creature

EFFECT

Duration 1 time unit/(effective spell level + ability modifier) or discharged (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The paper of this ofuda sticks to the body of the bearer to provide protection against fire. This charm bestows 5 points of fire resistance +1 fire resistance for every sutra caster level. Fire charms created by characters with a sutra caster level of 20th or higher provide immunity to fire.

This sutra has a duration measured in Time Units equal to the effective spell level + the sutra caster’s sutra ability modifier.
